policies.name: Act on Promotion of Resource Circulation for Plastics
policies.summary: Requires producers, retailers, and municipalities to design out single-use plastics, set reduction targets, and report progress.

sources.note: Confirm latest text and effective date with primary source.

newsFeed.headline: Microplastic levels in Tokyo Bay sediments still rising, researchers report
newsFeed.summary: A multi-year monitoring study found microplastic concentrations in Tokyo Bay continued to rise through 2024 despite domestic recycling gains.

wooby.headline: Japan recycles a lot — but the bay is still full of tiny plastic.
wooby.narrative: Wooby swims near Beppu and watches recycling trucks all day. Japan recycles more bottles than almost anyone, but tiny pieces of plastic still drift down to the seabed. Wooby says: recycling helps, but using less plastic helps even more.
